title: Pricing: Starter, Pro and Premium Plans | AIVideosUGC
description: AIVideosUGC pricing: Starter at $24.50, Pro at $35 or Premium at $63 a month, with 200 to 600 credits for product photos and videos. Compare plans today.
h1: AIVideosUGC Pricing for Product Photos and Videos
lead: AIVideosUGC pricing is three monthly plans. Use the credits on product photos or short video ads, and check the credit cost before each job starts.
card: Starter, Pro, and Premium, with a set credit balance each month.
intro: Choose a monthly plan by how many photos and videos you need. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits, Pro is $35 with 300, and Premium is $63 with 600. A listing photo and a vertical ad draw from the same balance.
credits_explained: Credits pay for the jobs you run. A product photo is 24 credits. A video is 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. That number is on screen before you confirm.
Credits are held when a job starts and spent when the file arrives. If the job fails, those credits return to your balance on their own.
teams: Need more credits than Premium includes? Email support@aivideosugc.com with how many photos and videos you make in a month.

faq.q: Which plan should a small shop start with?
faq.a: Start on Starter at $24.50 for 200 credits when you refresh a few listings. Move to Pro at $35 for 300 credits, or Premium at $63 for 600, when weekly ad tests need more jobs.

faq.q: Can the same credits pay for photos and videos?
faq.a: Yes. Photos and videos come out of one credit balance, and each job shows its credit cost before you confirm.

faq.q: Can I get a refund for a result I do not like?
faq.a: A failed job returns its reserved credits automatically. If a delivered file does not match what you asked for, use the [Refund Policy](/refunds) to request a review, then email support.

faq.q: Are uploads private on every plan?
faq.a: Yes. On Starter, Pro, and Premium, your uploads and finished files stay in your account and are not published. The [AI content trust and safety](page:trust) page spells out what that covers.

faq.q: What happens to credits when a job fails?
faq.a: The reserved credits go back to your balance automatically. If the balance does not update, check the job status and your credit history, then email support with the time of the job.

faq.q: How many credits does a photo or video use?
faq.a: A product photo is 24 credits. Video is 24 for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. You see that number before the job starts. Video frames are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4. Product photos are square.

faq.q: Can I use the photos and videos in ads?
faq.a: Yes. You can use downloaded photos and videos in your own ads, on product pages, and in social posts. Follow each platform's rules when you publish.
No. Downloaded photos and videos do not include an AIVideosUGC watermark.
